# temps_status_page_domain (Resource)

A custom hostname for a status page. Create the records in `dns_records` at your DNS provider; Temps verifies them and issues a certificate. `status` reports progress (`pending`, `active`, `failed`, ...).

Import with `<status_page_id>/<domain_id>`.

Required API key permissions: `status_page:read`, `status_page:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_status_page_domain" "status" {
  status_page_id = temps_status_page.public.id
  hostname       = "status.example.com"
}

# Point these records at Temps before verification can succeed.
output "status_dns_records" {
  value = temps_status_page_domain.status.dns_records
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) Hostname, for example `status.example.com`.
- `status_page_id` (Number) ID of the status page.

### Optional

- `verification_method` (String) `http-01` (default) or `dns-01`.
- `verify_on_apply` (Boolean) Ask Temps to verify the DNS records right after creating the domain. A failed check is reported in `status` and `last_error`, not as an apply error.

### Read-Only

- `dns_records` (Attributes List) DNS records to create. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_records))
- `id` (String) Numeric domain ID.
- `last_error` (String) Last verification or certificate error.
- `serving` (Boolean) Whether the hostname is serving the page.
- `status` (String) Verification and certificate status.

<a id="nestedatt--dns_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dns_records`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Record name.
- `purpose` (String) What the record is for.
- `record_type` (String) Record type, for example `CNAME` or `TXT`.
- `value` (String) Record value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <status_page_id>/<domain_id>
terraform import temps_status_page_domain.status 2/4
```
